items.html: These NHY of AA are the secret of the three drops of Segol mentioned in Tikkun 69, pages 107 and 108, from which the lower man is made, who is ZA. And it is found that the root of this drop is only from the phase of the three drops of NHY alone, except that they were included in HGT; and thus it is found that ZA now has only the phase of three ends alone, which are its NHY, and these are now completed and revealed, but they were also included in its own HGT, similar to Arich as mentioned.
